notes: «كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ» : Suleiman received the letter, so the Imam written as the writer is the last link; the kunya «أبو الحسن» is kept as written.
«أبي» is the compiler's father, a bare relation.
The compiler's remark that the report may come from one of two Imams is not a link and is left out; no identity is decided here.
